items.a: TinyFloor is a virtual office you walk around in. Your team appears as pixel-art characters on a shared 2D floor, and a video or voice call starts when you stand next to someone instead of when you click a meeting link.

items.q: How does proximity video chat work?
items.a: Walk up to someone and the call buttons appear next to them; tap one to start a video or voice call. Calls run over WebRTC through Cloudflare's network, so they connect on any office or home network, and they stay up until someone hangs up. Meeting tables carry group calls: sit down to join, stand up to leave.
Yes. The public lobby is free for everyone, and so is an office for up to 3 people. Plans for bigger teams are coming soon.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No. TinyFloor runs in the browser on desktop and mobile. Open a room link and you are inside the office.

items.q: Do I need an account to join a room?
items.a: Not for the public lobby. Anyone can walk in there as a guest with just a name. Rooms in a workspace are private: teammates sign in with a free account, and visitors come in through a guest link.

An office floor is only for its members and the guests they let in, and nothing inside it is public or indexed by search engines. Calls are encrypted in transit by WebRTC, and your camera and microphone are only on during a call.

items.q: How is TinyFloor different from Zoom or Google Meet?
items.a: Zoom and Google Meet put everyone in one grid until the meeting ends. A TinyFloor office stays open all day, so you can see who's around, drift between conversations and talk to whoever you walk over to, without scheduling a call.

gather.label: Gather alternative

meta.title: Free Gather Alternative in Your Browser
meta.description: Looking for a free Gather alternative? TinyFloor is a pixel-art virtual office with proximity video calls. No trial, no per-seat price, nothing to install.

gather.title: A free Gather alternative.
gather.subtitle: Gather dropped its free plan and now charges per member. TinyFloor keeps the same idea, an office you walk around and talk in, and keeps it free.

points.title: No trial clock
points.body: Gather gives you 30 days before you pay. TinyFloor has no trial, because there is nothing to upgrade to.

points.title: Nothing to install
points.body: Everything runs in the browser on desktop and mobile. Share a link and your team is inside in seconds.

points.title: Guests walk straight in
points.body: Teammates join with a free account, and anyone else can come in through a guest link with just a name.

faq.a: No. Gather no longer has a permanent free plan. It offers a 30-day trial, then the Essential plan starts at $12 per member per month. TinyFloor is free.

faq.q: What does Gather have that TinyFloor does not?
faq.a: Gather adds AI meeting notes and office customization. TinyFloor focuses on the core: walking around, proximity calls, screen sharing, a meeting table, chat, a whiteboard and room music.

faq.q: Can I move my team from Gather to TinyFloor?
faq.a: Yes. Create a workspace, invite your team with one link, and everyone walks in. There is no data to migrate and nothing to install.

faq.q: How many people fit in a TinyFloor room?
faq.a: A room holds up to 20 people at once, and you can open as many rooms as you need.

meta.title: About TinyFloor
meta.description: TinyFloor is a virtual office you walk around in, made by Jitto Joseph. Why it exists, who makes it and how to get in touch.

about.title: Remote work lost the hallway. We're building it back.
about.p1: Working apart is great for focus, but it quietly took away the small moments: the quick question at someone's desk, the hello on the way past, seeing who's around. Video calls handle meetings well. They made every other conversation a scheduled one.
about.p2: TinyFloor is a floor instead of a link. Your team walks around a shared pixel-art office, and walking up to someone is how you start talking. Sit at a table and you're in a meeting. Walk away and it's quiet again.
about.p3: It runs in the browser on Cloudflare's network, in 18 languages, with nothing to install, and it's free for small teams.
about.founderBody: I design and build TinyFloor, from the pixel floor to the servers it runs on. If you have an idea, a problem or just want to say hello, I'd love to hear from you.
